gaps.title: Extra fights cannot buy safety
gaps.detail: Over-level EXP is cut to 0.2x and the cap is 30, so fighting three times as many battles puts a child only about one level ahead at each boss, and an Attack-only child hits the cap with nowhere to grow. Raise the over-level floor to about 0.6 and the cap to 40 (extend EXP_TABLE and growth anchors) so grinding always helps.
